title: Frequently asked questions
contactSupportText: Can't find the answer to your question? Write to us

items.question: What is DoGood Impact Inc.?
items.answer: It is a mission-driven tech company building the next-generation global mutual aid platform. We are building a digital bridge where kindness, amplified by Artificial Intelligence (AI), becomes visible, measurable, and contagious.

items.question: What problem does DoGood solve?
items.answer: We solve the paradox that millions of people are ready to give, and millions are in urgent need, yet these two groups too often fail to find each other due to fragmentation, a lack of trust, and the complexity of finding ways to help.

items.question: Is DoGood just an app or a social network?
items.answer: DoGood is more than an app or social network. It is a full digital ecosystem that turns good intentions into verified action and real-world impact.

items.question: Who can join DoGood?
items.answer: Anyone can join DoGood — individuals, volunteers, donors, people in need, NGOs, and businesses.

items.question: Is DoGood free to use?
items.answer: Basic participation on DoGood is free. Optional premium features are available for advanced analytics, organizational tools, or enhanced visibility.

items.question: In which countries does DoGood operate?
items.answer: DoGood is built with global scalability in mind. The initial launch will take place in the United States, after which the platform will expand into Europe, starting with the German market.

items.question: Who can become a volunteer on DoGood?
items.answer: Anyone with time, skills, or simply a willingness to help can become a volunteer. DoGood is designed or people who want to make an impact — whether they have five minutes, professional expertise, or long-term availability.

items.question: How does DoGood help me find the right volunteering opportunities?
items.answer: GoodBot AI analyzes your skills, interests, location, and availability to match you with verified causes where your contribution will have the greatest impact.

items.question: Can I volunteer both locally and internationally?
items.answer: Yes. Through GoodMap, you can discover nearby opportunities or support global initiatives, depending on your preferences and capacity.

items.question: How do I know my help actually made a difference?
items.answer: Every completed action is tracked and transformed into a measurable impact report. Your contribution becomes visible, verifiable, and part of your personal impact history.

items.question: What motivates volunteers on DoGood beyond altruism?
items.answer: The platform includes gamification elements such as achievements, levels, and reputation scores, helping volunteers feel progress, recognition, and a sense of shared purpose.

items.question: How does DoGood ensure that my donation is used responsibly?
items.answer: All requests go through verification assisted by GoodGuard AI, and transparency is reinforced through the Karma Index and future Proof-of-Good blockchain verification.

items.question: Can I make small or recurring donations?
items.answer: Yes. GoodCoins are designed for micro-donations, allowing you to support causes flexibly and consistently, even with small amounts.

items.question: Will I be able to track the impact of my donation?
items.answer: Absolutely. Donors receive clear, traceable reports showing how their contribution was used and what real-world impact it created.

items.question: I Can I donate without being publicly visible?
items.answer: Yes. DoGood respects privacy while still maintaining transparency and accountability within the system.

items.question: Who can request help on DoGood?
items.answer: Individuals, families, or communities facing urgent or ongoing needs can submit a request for support through the platform.

items.question: What types of help can I request?
items.answer: Requests can range from material aid and financial assistance to knowledge, skills, emotional support, or volunteering time.

items.question: How does DoGood protect people in need from fraud or exploitation?
items.answer: All requests undergo an initial verification process supported by GoodGuard AI to ensure safety, legitimacy, and dignity.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use DoGood?
items.answer: No. The platform is designed to be intuitive and accessible, ensuring that people in need can easily connect with support.

items.question: How long does it take to receive help?
items.answer: Response time depends on urgency, location, and available helpers, but the system prioritizes critical cases.

items.question: How can NGOs benefit from joining DoGood?
items.answer: NGOs gain access to a global pool of verified volunteers, donors, and partners, all coordinated through a single digital ecosystem.

items.question: How does DoGood help NGOs manage resources more efficiently?
items.answer: The platform reduces fragmentation by centralizing coordination, reporting, and volunteer management in one secure environment.

items.question: Can NGOs showcase their impact on DoGood?
items.answer: Yes. Verified impact reporting increases visibility, credibility, and trust among donors and volunteers.

items.question: Is DoGood suitable for both small local NGOs and large international organizations?
items.answer: Absolutely. The platform is built for scalability and supports organizations of all sizes.

items.question: How can businesses participate in DoGood?
items.answer: Companies can engage through CSR partnerships, enabling employees to volunteer, donate, and track social impact in a structured way.

items.question: What value does DoGood bring to corporate CSR programs?
items.answer: DoGood provides measurable impact analytics, transparent reporting, and meaningful employee engagement aligned with social values.

items.question: Can employee volunteering be tracked and reported?

items.question: Why is DoGood attractive for socially responsible brands?
items.answer: DoGood combines ethical AI, transparency, and human-centered design — helping brands align technology, trust, and real-world impact.
